Extract AgERA5 data formatted for APSIM

ag5_apsim.Rd

Extracts all AgERA5 meteorological variables required by the APSIM crop model for a single location and date range, applies the necessary unit conversions, computes the site constants tav and amp, and optionally writes the result to a classic APSIM .met file or an APSIM Next Generation .csv file.

Usage

ag5_apsim(
  coords,
  start_date,
  end_date,
  path,
  variables = "all",
  filename = NULL,
  format = c("classic", "apsimng"),
  download = FALSE,
  rh_time = "09h"
)

Arguments

coords

Numeric vector of length 2: c(lon, lat).

start_date

Character. Start date in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.

end_date

Character. End date in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.

path

Character. Path to the folder containing the downloaded AgERA5 .nc files.

variables

Controls which variables are extracted. Three forms are accepted:

  • "all" (default) — all supported variables: maxt, mint, rain, radn, wind, vp, rh.

  • "required" — only the four variables required by APSIM: maxt, mint, rain, radn.

  • A character vector of specific variable names drawn from the set above, e.g. c("maxt", "mint", "rain", "radn", "wind").

filename

Character or NULL. Output file path without extension. If NULL (default) the function returns an annotated data.frame and prints the site constants to the console. If provided, the file is written and the data.frame is returned invisibly.

format

Character. Output format: "classic" (default) writes a space-delimited APSIM .met file; "apsimng" writes a .csv data file and a companion _constants.txt file for APSIM Next Generation.

download

Logical. If TRUE, checks which required AgERA5 files are missing from path and downloads them via ag5_download() before extracting. The bounding box is derived automatically from coords. Default is FALSE.

rh_time

Character. Time of day for relative humidity extraction. One of "06h", "09h" (default), "12h", "15h", "18h". Only used when rh is among the requested variables.

Value

A data.frame with columns year, day, and one column per requested variable. When filename = NULL the data.frame carries tav, amp, latitude, and longitude as attributes and is returned visibly. When filename is provided the data.frame is returned invisibly.

APSIM variable mapping

APSIM columnAgERA5 variableStatisticUnit conversion
maxtTemperature-Air-2mMax-24hK to °C
mintTemperature-Air-2mMin-24hK to °C
rainPrecipitation-Flux—none (mm/day)
radnSolar-Radiation-Flux—J/m²/day ÷ 1e6 → MJ/m²/day
windWind-Speed-10mMeannone (m/s)
vpVapour-PressureMeannone (hPa)
rhRelative-Humidity-2m—none (%)

Site constants

tav (annual average temperature) and amp (half the range between the warmest and coldest monthly mean temperatures) are computed from the extracted data and written to the file header. When filename = NULL they are printed to the console and attached as attributes to the returned data.frame.

See also

ag5_download to download AgERA5 files from the CDS, ag5_extract to extract individual variables.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Return a data.frame (no file written)
met <- ag5_apsim(
  coords     = c(36.68, -3.37),
  start_date = "2015-01-01",
  end_date   = "2015-12-31",
  variables  = "required",
  path       = "C:/agera5/"
)

# Write a classic APSIM .met file with all variables
ag5_apsim(
  coords     = c(36.68, -3.37),
  start_date = "2015-01-01",
  end_date   = "2015-12-31",
  path       = "C:/agera5/",
  filename   = "C:/apsim/arusha",
  format     = "classic"
)

# Download missing files then write APSIM NG output
ag5_apsim(
  coords     = c(36.68, -3.37),
  start_date = "2015-01-01",
  end_date   = "2015-12-31",
  path       = "C:/agera5/",
  filename   = "C:/apsim/arusha",
  format     = "apsimng",
  download   = TRUE
)
} # }
